concurrency.title: One stale writer commits, the other conflicts
concurrency.summary: Both local threads read version zero; a barrier ensures the race precondition. The winning thread is unspecified.

nodes.label: Both read v0
nodes.description: Two proposals use the same old version.

nodes.label: Barrier
nodes.description: Neither updates before both have read.

nodes.label: Locked compare/write
nodes.description: Only one thread owns the critical section at a time.

nodes.label: One commit -> v1
nodes.description: The first valid proposal increments version.

nodes.label: Stale proposal rejected
nodes.description: The second expected version zero no longer matches.

steps.title: Establish shared old version
steps.explanation: The barrier creates the material precondition without choosing a winner.

steps.title: Commit one proposal
steps.explanation: Comparison and update occur under the same local lock.

steps.title: Reject the stale proposal
steps.explanation: Assert one success, one conflict and version one; do not require a particular thread to win.

integration-files.title: Validate before replacing the report
integration-files.summary: A complete batch is checked before any replacement; a failure must preserve old output.

nodes.label: Batch input
nodes.description: Synthetic JSON lines with a bound.

nodes.label: Validate all rows
nodes.description: Fields, types and duplicate IDs checked.

nodes.label: Temporary report
nodes.description: Serialization and flush in destination directory.

nodes.label: Failure branch
nodes.description: Keep old bytes and clean temporary artifacts.

steps.title: Prepare complete bytes
steps.explanation: The target remains old while a temporary report is built.

steps.title: Publish or clean up
steps.explanation: Real replacement is tested separately from an injected failure; this is not multi-writer coordination.
